beforePosting.text: Music: add it in the app for the launch-week videos, never for the teasers
beforePosting.how: The teasers (T7 and T8) already have their own music and sound effects: keep the original sound, add no platform music and skip TikTok's "add sound". The launch-week videos (V01 onwards) have no music: on TikTok pick a track from the Commercial Music Library, on Instagram the Meta music library, on YouTube Shorts the Shorts library; LinkedIn and X get none. Keep it low so the sound effects still click.

beforePosting.text: Switch on the GO, SITE, DECK and CLIENT DM keywords, and set the bio link
beforePosting.how: Every teaser asks for a "GO" comment; the launch videos say "Comment SITE", "DM me DECK" and "Comment CLIENT". Turn on the Instagram comment-to-DM automation for those four words first (Instagram playbook, template t21). Suggested GO reply: "Here you go: makeborne.com. It opens Thu 29 Oct at 21:00 CET; join the waitlist to get your invite." From 21:00 on Thursday, drop the second sentence. On TikTok and YouTube, reply by hand or pin a comment. Set makeborne.com as the bio link on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, because a link typed in a comment reply cannot be tapped.

beforePosting.text: Remove the "30-second uncut build" line from the DM
beforePosting.how: The keyword DM promises a 30-second uncut build, and that recording does not exist yet. Take the line out of the DM until it is recorded.
